desc: Area-of-effect / target shapes used by magic.dat attack_map. File: u16 count, u16 cell_count, count x 8-byte shape records, cell_count x 3-byte cells, then 3 trailing junk bytes ("gra"). Coordinates: x = sideways, y = forward (facing direction of the user, +y away from the user). Shapes that contain an origin cell (kind 3) are centred on the target cursor (skills with range > 0); shapes without it are placed relative to the user (range 0 skills, e.g. 1001 = the panel in front, 3000 = 3 panels in a line). Cells of kind 2 are where the user ends up (skills that move the user, e.g. 1100 Triple Strike). Id families roughly = cell count x 1000 (1000-1300 one/two panels, 9000 = 9 cells...), 1-9 / 101-122 small cursor shapes, 25000-25008 straight lines of 1..9, 30000 self, 31000 radius-5 diamond (60 cells). The last record (id 33464, cells 61..129) looks like leftover junk and is not referenced.

fields.name: cell_count
fields.desc: number of cells in the cells section

fields.name: first_cell
fields.desc: index of the first cell in the cells section (cells of a shape are contiguous)

fields.name: directional
fields.desc: 1 = shape rotates with the user facing (not 90-degree symmetric); 0 = rotation-symmetric shape (verified: 0 exactly for the 28 shapes that are invariant under 90-degree rotation)

fields.name: y
fields.desc: forward offset in panels (+ = away from the user, in the facing direction)

cells.desc: shape cells (3 bytes each); the shape record points into this list with first_cell/cell_num
